About me

I’ve always been curious. I like understanding how things work, fixing things and finding new solutions. Maybe that’s why I became an engineer, or maybe being an engineer is why I still like to tinker with everything.

Part of my day is about the defence industry, projects, problems to solve and, the hardest part, people :) The other part is about songs…

I sing Turkish classical and folk music, both as a soloist and in choirs.

They may seem very different from engineering, but I don’t really see it that way. I think you need to love what you do, whether it’s your work or a song.

Both take love, effort and a little courage.

I made this site not to tell a long story about myself, but to leave a few small traces of who I am. Because,

“Life is as delicate as a flower, as fleeting as a day.”
